page: Microsoft Azure E96ds_v6 is an Edsv6-family virtual machine configured with 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture with a clock speed of 4.2 GHz, this server features a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets including Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, and includes 5669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, with uncached read speeds reaching 506.7 GB/sec and write speeds at 207.77 GB/sec. The processor demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, scoring in the top 10% on Passmark CPU tests and showing high efficiency in database operations and Redis SET operations, which exceed 122 million operations per second. Additionally, the hardware-assisted AMX instructions support strong performance in LLM inference, processing 261.63 tokens per second for a medium 7B model.

Given its high memory density and integrated high-capacity NVMe storage, the E96ds_v6 offers a resource-dense profile that is highly efficient for memory-intensive enterprise applications. The combination of massive RAM, fast local storage, and high-throughput memory bandwidth makes this server type highly suitable for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers like Redis, data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise workloads.
